title: Jounieh Bay.jpg
author: Serouj
description:
Jounieh Bay, Lebanon, looking south, just north of the main bridge connecting Jounieh to Byblos.  (The bridge was destroyed in July, 2006, by Israeli missiles.)
At the right of the picture is the Mediterranean Sea.
Harissa, with the Statue of Notre Dame du Liban (Our Lady of Lebanon) and the Basilica of St. Paul, can be seen at the top of the mountain in the center of the image.
